items.summary: Weekend closures of County Road 16A between Timberwolf Trail and River Reach Parkway are scheduled 8 p.m. Friday to 5 a.m. Monday (Jul 31-Aug 3 and Aug 7-10) for First Coast Expressway pipe installation. Detour via SR 16 and SR 13.
items.title: County Road 16A Closures and Detours for Next Two Weekends
items.why_it_matters: County Road 16A closures and detours over consecutive weekends affect local travel.

items.source_name: Utility Department — Water and Boil Notices
items.summary: The county utility is inventorying water service line materials under the EPA Community Lead-Safe Hub program. Customers may be contacted to allow an inspection of the pipe from the street to the home.
items.title: Utility Department Water Service Line Material Inventory
items.why_it_matters: Lead pipe identification program affects drinking water safety. Some residents may be contacted for property access to inspect service lines. No lead pipes confirmed; this is a proactive inventory.

items.summary: St. Johns County Emergency Management urges residents to prepare for the 2026 Atlantic Hurricane Season, which began June 1. Highlights simple steps to protect lives and property.
items.title: Residents Urged to Prepare as 2026 Atlantic Hurricane Season Begins
items.why_it_matters: June 1 marks the start of hurricane season. Residents should review plans, sign up for Alert St. Johns, and know their evacuation zone.

items.source_name: Utility Department — Water and Boil Notices
items.summary: The Phase III Extreme Water Shortage remains in effect: outdoor irrigation is limited to one day per week and is prohibited 8 a.m.-6 p.m. Reclaimed-water irrigation is not included in the schedule.
items.title: Phase III Extreme Water Shortage Declaration — Active
items.why_it_matters: Ongoing irrigation restrictions affect all properties with landscaping. Reclaimed water users exempt. Violations may result in penalties. Drought conditions may lead to higher water costs.
